asserts: A render error in a console page shows the error view with the digest and a retry, never the thrown text, and error.tsx is a client component.

guard.ref: apps/admin/src/components/route-boundary.test.tsx#error.tsx renders the error view with the digest and the retry

why: Calls the AppError boundary and asserts it is the RouteBoundary error view with the error's digest and reset as its retry, and that the thrown message is not rendered; 'use client' is held by next build, whose SWC transform refuses an error.tsx that is not a client component.

asserts: The render-error probe page is not found unless ADMIN_ROUTE_PROBE is exactly 1, and only then throws its render error, after the founder check.
why: Calls the probe page with ADMIN_ROUTE_PROBE unset, blank, 0, true and ' 1' (not found each time) and with 1 (throws admin.route_probe.render_error, never notFound), and asserts the founder check runs first and a refused founder stops it.

asserts: The console's account search calls identity's accountDirectory.search query, which needs admin:compliance, accepts exactly the console's input and returns every field the console shows.

guard.ref: apps/admin/src/lib/account-search/search.test.ts#matches the procedure identity serves, with the fields it returns

why: Builds identity's own operator router and calls it: a query with a scope rule, refused FORBIDDEN for admin:read before any database read, answered for admin:compliance with the console's own input, the answer read by the console; its strict input and output schemas accept the console's input and a row of exactly the console's columns and refuse an extra field.

asserts: The approval the console asks for to open a KYC document is bound to the hash identity consumes for kyc.doc.get over { documentId }.

guard.ref: apps/admin/src/lib/kyc-documents/kyc-documents.test.tsx#is the approval identity’s own kyc.getDocument asks to consume for that document

why: Calls identity's real router (createIdentityRouter(...).createCaller, kyc.getDocument) with an approvals service that records each consume and then refuses: the one consume asked carries the console's approval ids, the target service, target id and expected version of the console's propose input, and the console's payloadHashFor(request), which still equals identityActionPayloadHash('kyc.doc.get', { documentId }).

asserts: The approval the console asks for to decide a selfie is bound to the hash identity consumes for kyc.selfie.decide over { selfieId, decision }.

guard.ref: apps/admin/src/lib/kyc-selfies/kyc-selfies.test.tsx#is bound to the selfie and the decision exactly as identity consumes it

why: The test still asserts the console's hash equals identityActionPayloadHash('kyc.selfie.decide', { selfieId, decision }) for both decisions; identity's router test 'decide: MFA, never the reviewer's own, ... the approval binds selfie and decision' (services/svc-identity/src/router.test.ts) asserts the consumed approval carries exactly that hash.

asserts: Every console page asks the module gate for its own module before anything else, so a switched-off module never renders.

guard.ref: apps/admin/src/lib/module-page-guard.test.ts#asks for its own module first, and does not render while it is off

why: Imports each page of MODULE_ROUTES and calls it with ADMIN_MODULES naming another module: it redirects to that module, the only guard call is its own module id, and the founder check is never reached.

asserts: Every trade desk room is behind the tradeops module gate, through its layout.

guard.ref: apps/admin/src/lib/module-page-guard.test.ts#guards every trade desk room through its layout

why: Calls TradeOpsLayout with tradeops off (redirects, guard asked for tradeops) and on (renders its children).

asserts: Each bills.ops.* and global.ops.* read on the pay desk names a query svc-bank serves.

guard.ref: apps/admin/src/lib/ops-desk/catalog.test.ts#every read names a QUERY that exists in the owning router (drift guard)

why: Looks the read up in svc-bank's recorded calls (wire-replay.golden/callers.json, written from the live router by procedureCallers and held equal to it by svc-bank's wire-replay test) and asserts it is a query.

asserts: The console checks maker programme terms, members and launch plans by exactly svc-trade's rule.

guard.ref: apps/admin/src/lib/trade-ops/maker-programme-model.test.ts#applies svc-trade’s own rule: the same exports, codes and answer for every input

why: Imports both models and asserts the same exports and constants, the same answer (ok, code, message, bound value) for a battery of blank, padded, out-of-range and malformed inputs, and the same approval bodies.

asserts: The console checks maker programme terms, members and launch plans by exactly svc-trade's rule.

guard.ref: apps/admin/src/lib/trade-ops/maker-programme-model.test.ts#applies svc-trade’s own rule: the same exports, codes and answer for every input

why: Same rewrite as the console side: svc-trade's model is imported and called, not read.
